title: Restore prompt history independently of transcript paging
outcome: Prompt history is reconstructed from the hydrated session.messages window. Bounded transcript paging now supplies only the newest 20-64 messages, so empty-composer ArrowUp/ArrowDown often sees no history or only the latest prompt. Introduce a bounded recent-prompt projection independent of visible transcript hydration and cover reload, paging, and keyboard navigation.
acceptance: Empty-composer ArrowUp recalls recent prompts after summary-state load and bounded tail hydration; repeated Up/Down traverses history and restores the empty draft; prompt history is bounded and preserved independently of visible transcript pages; backend/frontend contracts and persistence remain valid; relevant full quality gates pass.
